verdict.rationale: Elastic publishes an official MCP server repository (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch), so an agent can connect to Elasticsearch through a first-party MCP server. The evidence only shows that the repo exists and is official. It does not document what the server does, how to set it up, or how agents connect to it. missing for 10: documented tool or capability list, setup and client-connection instructions, maintenance or support status (e.g. GA vs experimental), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
